:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EPatient complaints of cough, soreness of throat and tingling sensation of lower limbs since 10 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 days back. Later he developed shortness of breath, cough which was insidious in onset with whitish colour sputum, non blood stained. He also developed tingling sensation in lower limbsand burning sensation of palms and soles.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ENo history of HTM\/DM\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ENo history of asthma\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EHistory of Tb 1 and half yrs back.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EDiet - Mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ESleep - Normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EAppetite - Lost\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EAddictions -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Alcohol - Regular alcohol, 20 days back he took alcohol 60ml each day for 15 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Smoking - 4 years back 20 cigarettes per day for 25 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EAllergies - None\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EBowels - Regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EMicturition - Normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EFAMILY HISTORY\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ENo relevant family history.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EPatient is conscious ,coherent ,cooperative well orientated to time ,space and person.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ENo pallor ,cyanosis ,lymphadenopathy, icterus ,clubbing ,oedema\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003EVITALS\u003C\/u\u003E :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;
